description: This file contains utility methods for testing and manipulating EntityTag-related response objects, such as modifying headers to include ETag information, and creating mock responses for policy and resource objects within the Ditto policies persistence tests.

classes.name: ETagTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating and manipulating policy-related response objects with ETag headers for testing purposes.

methods.name: modifyPolicyEntryResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying a policy entry, including setting the ETag header, indicating if the entry was created or modified.

methods.name: retrievePolicyEntryResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a policy entry with an ETag header.

methods.name: modifyResourceResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying a resource, including ETag header, indicating if the resource was created or modified.

methods.name: retrieveResourceResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a resource with an ETag header.

methods.name: modifyPolicyResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying a policy with an ETag header, indicating if the policy was created or modified.

methods.name: retrievePolicyResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a policy with an ETag header.

methods.name: modifySubjectResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying a subject, including ETag header, indicating if the subject was created or modified.

methods.name: retrieveSubjectResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a subject with an ETag header.

methods.name: appendETagHeader
methods.description: Utility method to append an ETag header to the provided DittoHeaders based on the object’s entity.
